1.en_consolidated_definition:
Thus. "They were giving cresías (a type of joke or jest) for gabelas (a type of payment). –Shouting: Twenty cents to two pesos. –Fifteen to four. Three to two. –And thus they continued repeating." Alonso, Perico and . (Santa Teresa wrote: "Thus the poor soul...")

Nota: La traducción de "cresías" y "gabelas" puede variar dependiendo del contexto, pero en este caso se refiere a un tipo de broma o chiste y una forma de pago, respectivamente.
